title: spec review: Q2 v4: orchestrator/planner_telemetry.py — per-invocation Planner rows (launch, usage, materiality, skips), per-goal and per-accepted-goal Fable/Opus aggregation, interactive transcript attribution by day overlap (P1)
spec:
Why: headless Planner usage is logged only as bus.log_run role planner_decision rows (planner_runs._record_decision_usage, lines 566-620) with no model, decision type or materiality; interactive Fable transcript tokens are pool-wide (Pool.tally_planner -> planner_usage.json) with no per-goal share. The brief (P1) needs Planner tokens per material decision and Fable tokens per accepted goal. Spec reviews T-0677, of T-0690 and of T-0698 are folded in: constraints.fix_round_for, reserved result.escalate, day-overlap attribution, root resolution, thread-safe root-scoped writes, goal-scoped plan hash anchored on '## ' headings (the H1 title also names the open goal id and must be excluded), valid call syntax, goal filter aligned with scorecard.accepted_goals.
What: new module orchestrator/planner_telemetry.py. Rows never contain prompts, transcripts or chain-of-thought; free text capped at 300 chars. Every function takes root=None and resolves `root = Path(root) if root is not None else STATE` first.
- Writing: private _append(name, row, root) writes json.dumps(row) + newline to root/"runs"/"sched"/f"{name}.jsonl" (mkdir parents, setdefault ts, "a" mode): schedlog's file layout WITHOUT touching schedlog.SCHED_DIR or any module global, so concurrent daemon threads with different roots cannot interleave. Private _read(name, root) -> (rows, malformed_count) parsing line by line (json errors counted, never raised). With root = STATE the files are exactly runs/sched/planner_invocations.jsonl and planner_skips.jsonl, readable by schedlog.read.
- record_launch(*, launch_id, goal_id, event, decision_type, kind, payload_keys, model, tier, account, complexity, band, task_class, architectural, route, route_reason, mode, state_version, packet_chars, started_at, reescalation=False, root=None) -> row phase "launch".
- record_usage(launch_id, *, input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, cache_read_tokens=0, cache_write_tokens=0, usd=None, latency_s=None, outcome, session_id=None, root=None) -> row phase "usage"; total_tokens = input + output + cache_read // 10 (pool formula, Pool.tally_planner).
- goal_plan_section(goal_id, root=None) -> str|None: in root/plan.md, the text from the first line that starts with '## ' (exactly two hashes then a space; the H1 title line is never a match) and contains goal_id as a whole token (regex r'(?<![\w-])' + goal_id + r'(?![\w-])'), up to the next line starting with '## ' or EOF; None when plan.md is missing or no such heading exists. snapshot(goal_id, root=None) -> {"tasks": {task_id: {"status", "depends_on", "hold_reason", "fix_round_for" ((task.get("constraints") or {}).get("fix_round_for")), "result_escalate" (bool((task.get("result") or {}).get("escalate")); RESERVED: no producer sets result.escalate today, documented in the docstring as a forward-compatible hook), "parent", "created_at"}} over the goal and its children read from root/tasks/*.json, "plan_hash": sha256 of goal_plan_section(goal_id) or None}.
- materiality(before, after) -> {"material": bool, "new_tasks": [ids in after not in before], "dependencies_changed": [ids whose depends_on differ], "fix_strategy_for": [ids that gained a child with fix_round_for == id], "escalated": bool (a task whose hold_reason newly contains 'escalat', or whose result_escalate turned True, or the goal task itself newly status held/failed; judged from the tasks dicts only), "plan_changed": both hashes non-None and different}; material when any list non-empty or plan_changed or escalated. record_materiality(launch_id, before, after, root=None) -> row phase "materiality".
- record_skip(*, goal_id, event, reason, kind=None, payload_key=None, root=None) -> row in planner_skips.
- read_invocations_with_malformed(root=None) -> (rows merged by launch_id, later phases overriding earlier fields, malformed_count); read_invocations(root=None) -> rows only.
- per_goal(goal_id, root=None) -> {"planner_tokens", "fable_tokens", "opus_tokens", "other_tokens", "calls", "fable_calls", "opus_calls", "escalations" (rows with tier fable and route escalate), "reescalations", "material_decisions", "tokens_per_material_decision" (None when 0 material), "skips", "usd"}; tier buckets fable/opus/other.
- accepted_goal_summary(root=None) -> over scorecard.accepted_goals(root) with the resolved root: {"n_goals", "planner_tokens_per_accepted_goal", "fable_tokens_per_accepted_goal", "fable_calls_per_accepted_goal", "fable_share", "planner_tokens_per_material_decision", "planner_usd_per_accepted_goal"}; None values when no goals.
- interactive_by_goal(root=None, cfg=None, now=None, days=30) -> list of {"goal_id", "days": [iso dates], "tokens", "model", "model_source": "assumed_models_planner", "method": "day_overlap_approximate"}: cfg defaults to bus.pool_config(); now defaults to time.time(); call planner_runs._interactive_summary(root, cfg, now - days * 86400, now, []) (all positional, signature at planner_runs.py:794) and use its day_totals; tokens per day via the pool formula; split each day's tokens across goals open during that day (goal = task with role in ("triage", "goal") and no parent, the same definition scorecard.accepted_goals uses) proportionally to the seconds each goal was open within the day (created_at .. its done event ts or now); a day with no open goal reports under goal_id None. Approximation documented in docstring and method field.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_launch_usage_materiality_merge_by_launch_id — three phases for one launch_id under a sandbox root read back as one row with model, total_tokens (cache_read // 10 formula) and material fields, and schedlog.SCHED_DIR is unchanged after the writes

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_materiality_detects_new_task_dependency_change_and_fix_strategy — snapshots before/after with a new child whose constraints.fix_round_for names a held task and a changed depends_on give material True, list both and name the held id under fix_strategy_for; identical snapshots give material False; result_escalate turning True flips escalated

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_plan_hash_is_goal_scoped_and_ignores_h1 — a plan.md whose H1 title mentions T-0001 and holds '## GOAL T-0001' and '## GOAL T-0002' sections: editing the H1 or the T-0002 section leaves T-0001's plan_hash unchanged and plan_changed False; editing the T-0001 section flips plan_changed; a plan.md without a '## ' heading for the goal gives plan_hash None and plan_changed False; T-0001 does not match a heading mentioning T-00010

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_per_goal_and_accepted_goal_summary — two invocations (tier fable, tier opus) and one skip give fable_tokens, opus_tokens, calls 2, skips 1, tokens_per_material_decision over material rows only; two accepted goals give fable_tokens_per_accepted_goal and fable_share; no accepted goals gives None values without raising

tests/test_planner_telemetry.py::test_interactive_by_goal_day_overlap_is_marked_approximate — with planner_runs._interactive_summary patched to return two day_totals rows, tokens split across two goals (one role triage, one role goal) open on those days proportionally to open seconds, every row carries method day_overlap_approximate and model_source assumed_models_planner, and a malformed invocations line is counted by read_invocations_with_malformed

risks.issue: interactive_by_goal needs 'its done event ts' to bound the open interval for day-overlap attribution, but the repo has no 'done' event: bus events are only kind 'created'/'update' (bus.py _event calls), and per-task done-ness lives either in the sqlite events table (kind='update', data={'status':'done'}) or in the task's own embedded events list (bus.update appends to t['events']). The spec names neither source, and doesn't say what happens if a goal task goes done then reopens (first vs last done event).

accepted_goal_summary lists a 'fable_share' field with no defined formula (share of tokens vs calls vs planner_tokens; per-goal average vs sum-of-fable/sum-of-planner). The acceptance test only checks the key exists, not its value, so two compliant implementations could disagree.

suggested_spec_changes: Specify the exact source and tie-breaking rule for a goal's 'done event ts' in interactive_by_goal (e.g. 'the ts of the last entry in the goal task's own events list where fields.get("status")=="done"'), and state what interactive_by_goal does if the goal is currently open with no done event other than falling back to now.

Define fable_share explicitly, e.g. 'sum(fable_tokens across accepted goals) / sum(planner_tokens across accepted goals), None when planner_tokens sum is 0', and add an acceptance assertion pinning the value.
